changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetRelationshipDisplayValue] ( @o varchar(50), @oid int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select DV.DisplayValue from Asset A inner join AssetDisplayValue DV on DV.AssetID = A.ID where @o not in('Policy', 'Taxonomy') and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union select AT.Name as DisplayValue from AssetType AT where @o = 'ReferenceItemType' and AT.[Object] = @o and AT.ObjectID = @oid union all select P.DisplayPath as DisplayValue from Asset A inner join AssetPath P on P.ID = A.ID where @o in('Policy', 'Taxonomy') and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid )
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetRelationshipDisplayValue] ( @o varchar(50), @oid int ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( select DV.DisplayValue from dbo.Asset A inner join dbo.AssetDisplayValue DV on DV.AssetID = A.ID where @o not in('Policy', 'Taxonomy') and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid union select AT.Name as DisplayValue from dbo.AssetType AT where @o = 'ReferenceItemType' and AT.[Object] = @o and AT.ObjectID = @oid union all select TextPath from dbo.Asset A cross apply [dbo].GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID,'/') where @o in('Policy', 'Taxonomy') and A.[Object] = @o and A.ObjectID = @oid )
